senses.gloss: pr. n. m.Lulianus (popular corrupt. of Julianus)

name of an influential man who suffered a martyr’s death together with one Papus. Sifra B’ḥuck., Par. 2, ch. V (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 26:19">Lev. XXVI, 19</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00005"><he>גֵּאֶה</he></cite>) <he>כגון פפוס בן יהודה ול׳ אלכסדרי וכ׳</he> like P. son of Judah and L. the Alexandrian and his associates.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:12:3">Y. Taan. II, 66ᵃ</cite> top <he>יום … ל׳ ופ׳</he> the day on which L. and P. were put to death; Bab.
<cite ref="Taanit 18b:8">Taan. 18ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="L00280"><he>לוּלְיָנ׳</he></cite>; v. fr., v. <cite ref="L00204"><he>לוּדְקְיָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 3:2:2">Y. Ned. III, 37ᵈ</cite> bot.; (Y. Shebu. III, 34ᵈ <cite ref="D00334"><he>דוקליטיאנוס</he></cite>).
